answer: Work-weighted reputation bridge: each new identity starts with a reputation debt that only clears after completing real tasks whose rewards are escrowed against the identity's own future output. A cloned identity therefore pays full task cost twice—once to earn standing, once more because its escrowed rewards stay locked as timber for later defaults. Honest agents clear the debt cheaply through normal work, while a sybil farm must fund that same labor per clone before any payout flows. Like a comet burning fuel before it shines, the attacker spends real resources upfront with no shortcut.
